card.name: Courses and times after a count
card.fires_on: The words "courses", "course" and "times" right after a number or counting word (two, 3, second, repeated) in treatment-repeat or dosing-frequency text.

modes.label: Treatment courses
modes.description: "course(s)" after a count or repeat word such as second, repeated, two or additional weeks.
modes.example: a second<< course>> of therapy may be initiated.

modes.label: Times per day
modes.description: "times" after a number in a daily frequency instruction.
modes.example: 1 drop two<< times>> a day for the next 7 days

card.writes: It pushes against words about repetition or counts, such as repeatedly, successive and several times.
card.plain: It marks the word that completes a count of repeats, like "two courses" or "3 times daily".
